faq.college: Nalanda College of Engineering (NCE), Chandi is a Government Engineering College established in 2008. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated with Bihar Engineering University (BEU).
faq.about: Nalanda College of Engineering provides quality technical education with experienced faculty, modern laboratories, library, hostels and Wi-Fi campus.
faq.admission: B.Tech admission is through UGEAC counselling based on JEE Main rank. M.Tech admission follows the postgraduate admission process.
faq.btech: B.Tech admission is through UGEAC counselling after qualifying JEE Main.
faq.mtech: M.Tech admission is based on the postgraduate admission process as per institute rules.
faq.fees: Fee details are available in the official admission brochure. Students should refer to the latest admission notification.
faq.hostel: Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls.
faq.library: The college has a central library with academic books, journals and digital resources.
faq.wifi: Wi-Fi facility is available on campus.
faq.placement: The Training & Placement Cell organizes internships, training programs and campus recruitment.
faq.principal: Please refer to the official NCE website for the latest Principal information.
faq.director: Please refer to the official NCE website for the latest Director information.
faq.contact: Visit https://ncechandi.ac.in/ for official contact details.
faq.departments: The college offers B.Tech programmes in Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Electronics & Communication Engineering.
faq.cse: Computer Science & Engineering department provides programming, software development, database, networking and project-based learning.
faq.ai ml: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning department focuses on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Science and Python programming.
faq.civil: Civil Engineering department provides education in structural engineering, transportation, surveying and environmental engineering.
faq.mechanical: Mechanical Engineering department covers manufacturing, thermal engineering, CAD/CAM and industrial engineering.
faq.electrical: Electrical Engineering department focuses on power systems, electrical machines, control systems and electrical laboratories.
faq.ece: Electronics & Communication Engineering department teaches digital electronics, communication systems, embedded systems and VLSI basics.
faq.lab: Modern laboratories are available in all engineering departments for practical learning.
faq.sports: The campus provides sports and extracurricular activity facilities for students.
faq.canteen: Canteen facilities are available inside the college campus.
faq.transport: Students should check the official website for transport-related information.
faq.scholarship: Eligible students can apply for scholarships as per Bihar Government and institute guidelines.
faq.training: The Training and Placement Cell conducts aptitude training, technical sessions, mock interviews and career guidance.
faq.internship: Students are encouraged to participate in internships through the Training and Placement Cell.
faq.gallery: Campus photographs and event images are available in the Gallery section of this application.
faq.address: Nalanda College of Engineering, Chandi, Nalanda, Bihar.
faq.location: The college is located at Chandi in Nalanda district of Bihar.
